fields.description: Matches doc.ecommerce_sales_channel_name. Suggestions are pulled from Medusa Sales Channels and existing Sales Orders.
fields.label: Channel Name

fields.description: Human-readable shop/company name shown on documents and emails
fields.label: Display Name

fields.description: e.g., yourshop.com (shown in document header)
fields.label: Shop URL

fields.description: Main brand color (e.g., #C41E3A)
fields.label: Primary Color

fields.description: Darker shade for hover/borders (optional)
fields.label: Dark Color

fields.description: Uploaded image file (preferred)
fields.label: Logo

fields.description: Inline data URI fallback (used when Logo file is unavailable in PDFs)
fields.label: Logo Data URI

fields.description: Email Account used for order-related notifications (acknowledgment, order confirmation, delivery note, …). Falls back to the default outgoing account if empty.
fields.label: Outgoing Email Account (Orders)

fields.description: Email Account used for invoice-related notifications (Sales Invoice, Payment Entry, Payment Request). Falls back to the Orders account, then the system default.
fields.label: Outgoing Email Account (Invoices)

fields.description: Display name in the From header (e.g., 'My Shop')
fields.label: Sender Name

fields.description: Language used to render emails and PDFs sent to customers via this channel. Defaults to German; set a channel-specific language when needed.
fields.label: Language

fields.description: Internal BCC for every outgoing notification (optional)
fields.label: BCC Email

fields.description: When enabled, Sales Invoice emails sent through this channel get an XRechnung/ZUGFeRD XML attached as a separate file AND embedded into the PDF (Factur-X). Requires the eu_einvoice app and a configured E-Invoice Profile on the customer/company.
fields.label: Attach E-Invoice (XML + ZUGFeRD)

fields.description: Title on the order receipt PDF (sent to the customer immediately after order entry). Translated at render time via the channel language.
fields.label: Order Acknowledgment Title

fields.default: {{ _("We have received your order and are reviewing it:") }}
fields.description: Intro sentence on the order receipt PDF. Jinja supported — wrap fixed text in {{ _("...") }} to translate via the channel language.
fields.label: Order Acknowledgment Intro

fields.description: Title on the order confirmation PDF (after office release). Translated at render time via the channel language.
fields.label: Order Confirmation Title

fields.description: Intro sentence on the order confirmation PDF. Jinja supported — wrap fixed text in {{ _("...") }} to translate via the channel language.
fields.label: Order Confirmation Intro

fields.description: Title on the delivery note PDF. Translated at render time via the channel language.
fields.label: Delivery Note Title

fields.description: Intro sentence on the delivery note PDF. Jinja supported — wrap fixed text in {{ _("...") }} to translate via the channel language.
fields.label: Delivery Note Intro

fields.description: Subject line of the order receipt email. Jinja supported — wrap fixed text in {{ _("...") }} to translate via the channel language. Placeholders: {{ doc.name }} for the order number.
fields.label: Acknowledgment Email Subject

fields.description: Greeting at the top of the order receipt email. Jinja placeholders allowed: {{ first_name }}, {{ last_name }}, {{ salutation }}, {{ gender }}, {{ customer_name }}, {{ auto_greeting }} (locale-aware auto-greeting with fallback to 'Dear Sir or Madam').
fields.label: Acknowledgment Email Greeting

fields.default:
{{ _("thank you for your order. We have received your request and will process it as quickly as possible.") }}

{{ _("Below you will find an overview of the items you ordered.") }}
fields.description: Body of the order receipt email (HTML, Jinja placeholders supported: {{ doc.name }}, {{ doc.grand_total }}, plus {{ first_name }}, {{ last_name }}, {{ salutation }}, {{ gender }}, {{ auto_greeting }}). Wrap fixed text in {{ _("...") }} to translate via the channel language.
fields.label: Acknowledgment Email Body

fields.description: Subject line of the order confirmation email. Jinja supported — wrap fixed text in {{ _("...") }} to translate via the channel language. Placeholders: {{ doc.name }} for the order number.
fields.label: Confirmation Email Subject

fields.description: Greeting at the top of the order confirmation email. Jinja placeholders allowed: {{ first_name }}, {{ last_name }}, {{ salutation }}, {{ gender }}, {{ customer_name }}, {{ auto_greeting }} (locale-aware auto-greeting with fallback to 'Dear Sir or Madam').
fields.label: Confirmation Email Greeting

fields.default: {{ _("we hereby confirm your order as binding. Please find the details in the attached order confirmation.") }}
fields.description: Body of the order confirmation email (HTML, Jinja placeholders supported). Wrap fixed text in {{ _("...") }} to translate via the channel language.
fields.label: Confirmation Email Body

fields.description: Subject line of the invoice email. Jinja supported — wrap fixed text in {{ _("...") }} to translate via the channel language. Placeholders: {{ doc.name }} for the invoice number.
fields.label: Invoice Email Subject

fields.description: Greeting at the top of the invoice email. Jinja placeholders allowed: {{ first_name }}, {{ last_name }}, {{ salutation }}, {{ gender }}, {{ customer_name }}, {{ auto_greeting }} (locale-aware auto-greeting with fallback to 'Dear Sir or Madam').
